mapper.select: SELECT sch13_track_id AS track_id , sch13_stk_code AS stk_code , sch13_stk_name AS stk_name , sch13_market_type AS market_type , sch13_price_bracket AS price_bracket , sch13_lead_manager AS lead_manager , sch13_demand_date AS demand_date , sch13_subscription_date AS subscription_date , sch13_div_date AS div_date , sch13_pay_date AS pay_date , sch13_refund_date AS refund_date , sch13_list_date AS list_date , sch13_final_price AS final_price FROM sch13_ipo_crawling WHERE sch13_track_id = ( SELECT MAX(sch13_track_id) FROM sch13_ipo_crawling WHERE sch13_target_type = #{targetType} ) /*(1:공모주38 / 2:IPO-Stock)*/ AND TO_DATE((CASE WHEN COALESCE(sch13_list_date,'') = '' THEN '9999-12-31' ELSE sch13_list_date END),'YYYY-MM-DD') >= f_today() ORDER BY sch13_ipo_crawling_id DESC

SELECT sch10_ipo_id AS ipo_id , sch10_iss_corp_cd AS iss_corp_code , sch10_market_cd AS market_code , sch10_company_id AS company_id , sch10_item_nm AS item_name , sch10_demand_start_date AS demand_start_date , sch10_demand_close_date AS demand_close_date , sch10_subscription_start_date AS subscription_start_date , sch10_subscription_close_date AS subscription_close_date , sch10_div_date AS div_date , sch10_pay_date AS pay_date , sch10_refund_date AS refund_date , sch10_list_date AS list_date , sch10_note AS note , sch10_cancel_yn AS cancel_yn , sch10_price_bracket AS price_bracket , sch10_price AS price , COALESCE(sch14_check_yn,'false') AS mismatch_check_yn FROM sch10_ipo LEFT OUTER JOIN sch14_ipo_mismatch ON ( sch14_ipo_id = sch10_ipo_id AND sch14_ipo_mismatch_id = ( SELECT sch14_ipo_mismatch_id FROM sch14_ipo_mismatch WHERE sch14_ipo_id = sch10_ipo_id ORDER BY sch14_insert_date_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) ) WHERE sch10_iss_corp_cd = #{issCorpCode} AND sch10_market_cd = #{marketType} ORDER BY sch10_demand_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sch12_ipo_corp SELECT f_create_seq() , corpName FROM ( SELECT trim(unnest(string_to_array(unnest(string_to_array(#{leadManager},',')),'.'))) corpName EXCEPT SELECT sch12_corp_nm FROM sch12_ipo_corp ) t
mapper.update: UPDATE sch10_ipo SET sch10_cancel_yn = 'true' WHERE 1=1 AND sch10_demand_start_date >= f_today() + interval '-3month' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sch13_ipo_crawling LEFT OUTER JOIN sch15_ipo_item_matching ON sch15_item_cd = sch13_stk_code WHERE sch13_track_id = #{trackId} AND sch13_target_type = '1' AND SUBSTR(COALESCE(sch15_valid_item_cd, sch13_stk_code),1,5) = sch10_iss_corp_cd AND sch13_market_type = CASE WHEN sch10_market_cd = '1' THEN '거래소' WHEN sch10_market_cd = '2' THEN '코스닥' WHEN sch10_market_cd = '3' THEN '코넥스' WHEN sch10_market_cd = '4' THEN '유가증권' END ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sch14_ipo_mismatch WHERE sch14_ipo_id = sch10_ipo_id AND sch14_ipo_mismatch_id = ( SELECT sch14_ipo_mismatch_id FROM sch14_ipo_mismatch WHERE sch14_ipo_id = sch10_ipo_id ORDER BY sch14_insert_date_time DESC LIMIT 1 ) AND COALESCE(sch14_check_yn,'false') = 'true' )
